title: Race of the Rising Brine
story: Scuttlebrine the Tide Crab has plugged the sea cave's drain, and water is climbing the walls where three sleepy otter pups nap on a ledge. Mr 6 measures: the water is 42 centimeters below the ledge and rising 7 centimeters every 4 minutes. His rope ladder takes 20 minutes to rig.
question: How many minutes of spare time will Mr 6 have before the water reaches the ledge?
hint: How many 7-centimeter steps fit in 42 centimeters? Each step takes 4 minutes — then compare that total to the 20-minute rigging.
victory: The pups scamper up with four minutes to spare, and Scuttlebrine — outplanned by a number — unplugs the drain himself just to look useful.
imagePrompt: A huge barnacled crab clamping a stone drain in a sea cave as green water rises toward a ledge of otter pups, a caped number six racing up a rope ladder in the spray.
